form.helpSubtitle: Quick explanation of each form field.
form.helpCodeDesc: Unique identifier for the type. Letters, numbers, dashes or underscores only (2 to 20 characters). Cannot be changed after the type is created.
form.helpNameDesc: The name shown in menus and lists, e.g. “Laptop”.
form.helpPrefixDesc: Letters prefixed to each device number (e.g. LPT → LPT-0001). Max 15 letters or numbers, stored in uppercase only. Keep it short and clear.
form.helpFieldsDesc: Check “Show” to display the data when registering a device. A field can only be “Required” if it is marked as visible.
form.name: Name
form.prefixLockHint: The prefix cannot be changed after the type is created.
form.fieldsSectionHint: Define which data appears when registering a device and which are required.
